summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a heavily obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: Package @or-sdk/data-hub-svc@2.3.6 declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs on default `npm install`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with `_0xNNNN` identifiers and downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<arch>.zip` into a temp directory, chmods it executable (mode 493 / 0755), and invokes it via `execFileSync` on the sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB CJS bundle beginning `// @bun @bun-cjs`, with obfuscator.io fingerprints (large constant array `n7gIxM`, string-array rotation routine `WV8StW`, hex-mangled identifiers) that render its behavior non-reviewable. The package's advertised purpose is a data-hub SDK client, which has no functional need for a downloaded alternate runtime; executing under Bun rather than Node evades Node-based scanning and monitoring. The filename `math_init.js` bears no relation to any data-hub SDK function. Installing the package auto-executes attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
